subtitle: Your runtimes. One place. Ready for VR.
switchHint: Switching requires Windows administrator approval. Restart running VR apps afterwards. Applies to 64-bit OpenXR apps.
empty: No visible runtimes. Open Manage runtimes to add or show entries.
override: XR_RUNTIME_JSON is set and can override the system selection:
switchFailed: The runtime could not be changed.
portableHint: Settings and logos travel with the portable folder. Add translations as JSON files in lang. Missing keys fall back to English.
manageHint: Checked entries appear on the home screen. Changes are saved immediately. Logos and paths can be edited at any time.
name: Name
logo: Logo · clear the field to restore the default
invalid: Choose a valid OpenXR manifest with an existing x64 runtime DLL.
deleteConfirm: Remove this custom entry? The installed runtime is not deleted.
upToDate: No newer published release is available.
updatePrompt: Download and install this update now? The app will restart. Your portable settings, logos and existing language files will be preserved.
updateFailed: Update check failed. Try again from Info.
aboutText: Portable manager for the Windows 64-bit OpenXR system runtime. Games may override the system default. Settings: portable/settings.json. Translations: lang/*.json.
manageHintCompact: Show checked runtimes in the main window.
unlistedActive: The active system runtime is not included in this list.
adminHint: Confirm Windows permission once. Runtime changes then need no further prompt until the app exits.
helperExplanation: Optional: install a small Windows service with one administrator approval. It lets this Windows user select local x64 OpenXR runtimes without further UAC prompts. Even with the portable app, the helper is installed separately on the system. Before deleting the app folder, uninstall the helper here or through Windows Apps.
helperConfigured: Configured for this Windows user. Use Check to verify the service.
helperNotConfigured: Not configured. Runtime changes currently require administrator approval.
helperReady: Ready. Runtime changes no longer need a UAC prompt.
helperFailed: Helper unavailable or setup incomplete. Run Set up / repair. No automatic fallback to a UAC prompt while configured.
helperRemoved: Helper removed. The active runtime is unchanged. Runtime changes require UAC approval again unless the app runs as administrator.
helperRemoveFailed: Uninstall cancelled or failed. If necessary, repair the installation and try again.
